sections.h2: The 5 MMSCMD target is 12.5 times today's 0.4 MMSCMD output

chart.title: The 2035-36 target is 12.5 times what 217 commissioned plants make today
chart.sub: Compressed biogas, million standard cubic metres a day (MMSCMD).
chart.source: GOBARdhan portal, 6 Aug 2026 (via PIB); scheme target.

sections.means: Output has to rise from 0.4 to 5 MMSCMD a day, a multiple of 12.5, which the launch coverage called nearly ten-fold.
sections.todo: What to do: count the roughly 2,496 more plants needed at today's average output before relying on the 2035-36 date.

sections.h2: The 5% city-gas mandate could take about 2.3 MMSCMD, under half the target

chart.title: The 5% city-gas mandate could take about 2.3 MMSCMD, under half the target
chart.sub: Compressed biogas, million standard cubic metres a day (MMSCMD).
chart.source: PNGRB statistical booklet; GOBARdhan portal, 6 Aug 2026 (via PIB).

sections.means: The mandate covers only CNG and piped gas, so even 5% of all city-gas sales would take about 2.3 MMSCMD, under half the target.
sections.todo: What to do: name who buys the rest, through GAIL's pool, industry or pipelines, since the mandate cannot absorb the target alone.

sections.h2: The average plant makes about 1.3 tonnes a day, about a fifth of its reported size

chart.title: The average plant makes 1.3 tonnes a day, against about 7 reported in January
chart.sub: Tonnes a day per commissioned plant. The January figure is capacity, inferred from the reported total.
chart.source: GOBARdhan portal, 6 Aug 2026 (via PIB); MNRE-reported January 2026 figure.

sections.means: Output per plant, not plant count, is the first problem, since the average commissioned plant appears to run at about a fifth of the capacity reported in January.
sections.todo: What to do: publish plant capacity and utilisation on the portal, because the portal does not show them and the 19% figure is only an inference.

sections.h2: Only 24 of 207 functional plants are piped into a city-gas network

chart.title: Only 24 of 207 functional plants are linked to a city-gas pipeline

sections.means: Only 24 of 207 functional plants were piped into a city-gas network in August, with 15 more in progress.
sections.todo: What to do: fund pipeline links first, using the 50% support for a single plant's link, since gas that is not piped cannot reach the mandate.
